Poetry•Apr 24, 2026
1 min read

Some people leave quietly, but their absence never does. It sits at the corner of your tea cup, in the songs you used to skip, and in the quiet pauses between ordinary conversations.

A reflection on how the presence of certain people stays woven into the smallest rituals of our everyday lives long after they depart.

About Our Journal

PoetryKitaab — An Open Archive of Human Emotions

In a fast, fragmented digital world, PoetryKitaab is created as a slow, quiet space for poetry, shayari, and reflections. We curate words that speak to longing, resilience, love, and the quiet dignity of everyday life.

A modern digital poetry journal and archive dedicated to heartfelt verses, classic shayari, nazms, and quiet reflections. Designed for reading, introspection, and thoughtful sharing.
